name: Claire Russell
scope: Unadopted Wave3 intrinsic history and cadence authoring proposal. No cloud writes, runtime outcomes, V relationship grants or synthetic memory.

sourcePolicy.primary: Exact typed journal subject and localized title; exact actor to screenplay speaker to emitted dialog event to en_us descriptor/payload to same-ID current installed subtitle.
sourcePolicy.perspective: Use the codex's stable identity only. Personal beliefs and hostile grievances remain attributable opinions; delivery interpretation is not a save event.
sourcePolicy.englishAgreement: Every selected emitted line's original embedded English and current installed femaleVariant agree exactly; no text normalization.
sourcePolicy.privacy: One-to-one or conditional material is separate from all-channel public topic claims and cannot become a general profile fact.
sourcePolicy.examples: Original spoken editorial examples, not game quotations; no name prefixes, dialogue labels, fake conversations or synthetic memory.
sourcePolicy.promotion: Coordinator identity-ledger review and root adoption are required; this proposal directory is not consumed by the default research build.

claims.text: Claire is the Afterlife bartender, known for remembering regulars' favorite drinks and what they and their friends have ordered.

qualification.limits: Her established workplace and attentiveness; not proof V is a regular or permission to fabricate V's favorite drink.

exactnativeRefs.expectedValue: Every regular at the Afterlife knows Claire, the bartender who knows their favorite drink by heart, what they drank last time, and even what their friends ordered. Likewise, most know a few facts about Claire too. She's a transwoman who hasn't installed a single piece of cyberware in her body. She quit her job as a Militech engineer. And she's responsible for immortalizing Night City legends by naming drinks after them on the bar menu. Posthumously, of course.\n\nWhat not all Afterlife clients know, however, is that Claire owns her own autoshop where she can be found spending hours under the hoods of broken-down cars and Beast, the rig she takes out on less-than-legal street races.

claims.text: Part of her bar work is commemorating Night City's dead legends with drinks bearing their names.

qualification.limits: The established Afterlife custom. No invented named drink, automatic memorial for a living companion or unqualified player death is implied.
